coordinates.district_outline_policy: organic neighbourhood envelopes; intervening common landscape, roads and water are not extra districts

builder_contract.polygon_format: polygon exterior ring plus holes; rings are implicitly closed
builder_contract.angle_convention: degrees counterclockwise from east; facade outward normal, furniture forward vector
builder_contract.frontage_side: signage.side is zero-based edge index in footprint_m
builder_contract.alias_policy: instantiate only spawn_geometry=true; alias entries decorate physical_id once
builder_contract.building_geometry: footprint_m and floors copied from approved plan; no footprint/position/height edits
builder_contract.entrance_policy: entrances on facade; plan_access_m retains approved off-wall road connection
builder_contract.materials: nonoverlapping polygon partition; holes must be respected; building and water surfaces excluded
builder_contract.tree_clearance: reserved_radius_m includes crown envelope; furniture radius includes usage clearance
builder_contract.yard_fences: build only fence_polylines_m; do not close clipped boundaries or gate openings
builder_contract.district_border_fences: NONE: never instantiate legacy district fences from the source plan
builder_contract.source_barrier_policy: ignore all source fence materials; retain only canal_railing safety rails and rock_scarp terrain
builder_contract.property_fences: instantiate only elite_fences, industrial_fences and individual yards; industrial gate closes its 7m opening
builder_contract.waste_outfall: segments override full polyline elevation: buried sleeves beneath roads, rail, beach walk and fence; low supports elsewhere
builder_contract.parking: stalls[] are van-sized; access_polyline_m is existing-road connection; curb openings recorded
builder_contract.bus_stop: building_ref entries identify existing shelter; marker spawns separately
builder_contract.style: stylised slightly cartoon post-Soviet town; matte broad colour blocks, worn trims
builder_contract.variation: seeded irregular planting, asymmetric gardens and equipment, varied facades; approved slab grid retained

waste_outfall.crossing_policy: buried sleeves: pipe top 1.2m below unchanged paths/roads; no above-ground pipe or support occupies a corridor
